facts.fact: The course is on the east end of Fishers Island in Long Island Sound, with salt water in view from every tee and green.
Red nun buoys mark the channels of the Sound; the buoy here is generic, not a particular one (interpretation).

concepts.name: The Nun Buoy
concepts.rationale: A red nun buoy (a channel marker) afloat in the Sound, a white reflective band round it and a gull on its top.
concepts.strengths: One subject, no background, in the house style (developer 2026-10-25: no circular badges).
